root_cause.text: The rxrpc security handlers only checked for cloned skbs before unsharing, but failed to detect skbs with externally-owned paged fragments (indicated by SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG or frag_list), allowing in-place decryption to directly bind external pages into the AEAD/skcipher SGL, which could be modified by concurrent operations.
root_cause.evidence: The patch extends the condition from `skb_cloned(skb)` alone to `(skb_cloned(skb) || skb_has_frag_list(skb) || skb_has_shared_frag(skb))` in both rxrpc_input_call_event() and rxrpc_verify_response(). The CVE description explicitly states that "An skb that is not cloned but still carries externally-owned paged fragments...falls through to the in-place decryption path, which binds the frag pages directly into the AEAD/skcipher SGL via skb_to_sgvec()," demonstrating that the original check was insufficient to catch all cases of externally-shared memory that should not be used for in-place cryptographic operations.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing checks for fragmented and shared skb structures to ensure safe in-place decryption in RxRPC packet handling.
intent_record.what: Expanded the conditional check from a single `skb_cloned(skb)` call to a logical OR expression that additionally checks `skb_has_frag_list(skb)` and `skb_has_shared_frag(skb)` before triggering packet unsharing for in-place decryption.
intent_record.how: The change broadens the conditions under which an RxRPC packet is unshared before decryption. Previously, only cloned skbs would trigger unsharing; now packets with fragment lists or shared fragments will also be unshared. This prevents potential data corruption or security issues during in-place decryption operations on packets with complex buffer structures.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add checks for fragment lists and shared fragments to ensure packet copying occurs for all types of shared buffer structures before in-place decryption.
intent_record.what: Expanded the conditional check in rxrpc_verify_response from testing only `skb_cloned(skb)` to additionally test `skb_has_frag_list(skb)` and `skb_has_shared_frag(skb)` before copying the packet.
intent_record.how: The function now triggers packet copying in three cases instead of one: when the skb is cloned, when it has a fragment list, or when it has shared fragments. This ensures that all types of shared or complex buffer structures are copied before in-place decryption, preventing potential data corruption or memory safety issues that could occur if decryption operates on shared buffer memory.
